title: What Passes Between Two People
label: ch:mr-passing-verbs
canDo: I can ask someone to tell me their name, quote what I said, say that I am learning Marathi, and ask whether a thing is to be had -- carrying one of the four by ear because its letter is still owed to me.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R24-passing-verbs and run the exchange unaided: ask for a name with the by-ear verb, say you are learning Marathi, and ask whether water is to be had.
